attchmntText: BLS International Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: BLS International Services Limited filed a transcript of its earnings call held on November 04, 2026, discussing performance for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026. For Q2, consolidated revenue reached INR 973 crores, a 32% increase year-on-year. EBITDA grew 17% to INR 248 crores with a margin of 25.5%. Profit after tax was INR 403 crores for the first half, up 10%. The Visa and Consular Services segment reported revenue of INR 510 crores, up 11%, while the Digital Services segment revenue rose 66% to INR 463 crores. The company processed over 500 million applications globally. Net cash stood at INR 1,556 crores as of September 30, 2026. ICRA rated the company AA- for long-term and A1+ for short-term debt. Management expects net revenue per application to grow by 5% to 6% annually.

attchmntText: BLS International Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Completion of tenure of Mr. Sarthak Behuria as Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 10, 2026.
voiceSummary: BLS International Services Limited intimates that Mr. Sarthak Behuria, DIN 03290288, ceases to hold office as an Independent Director with effect from the close of business hours on November 10, 2026. This cessation follows the completion of his second term of five consecutive years, which commenced on November 11, 2021. Mr. Behuria was reappointed by members in a meeting held on September 24, 2021. Consequently, his membership in various Board committees has ceased. The composition of the Audit Committee, Nomination and Remuneration Committee, and Risk Management Committee is updated effective November 11, 2026. Mr. Atul Seksaria, Mr. Nikhil Gupta, Mrs. Dr. Savita, Mr. Ram Sharan Prasad Sinha, Mr. Manoj Joshi, and Mr. Shikhar Aggarwal are listed as members in the respective committees post-cessation. The Company expresses gratitude for Mr. Behuria's guidance and expertise during his tenure.
